prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync & Save Your Pet", "Use the exact same account you previously used to restore your existing desktop pets.", "Existing User? Sign in to recover your pets", "Continue with Account"]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop!", "Use your shortcut key anytime to toggle your pet or access settings.", "How to Interact With Your Pet", "Quick key combinations to manage your desktop companion.", "Double Click: Talk to pet | Right Click: Menu | Alt+H: Hide", "Got It!"]
2: ["If photo upload fails, you can pick from pre-rendered pet styles on the next screen.", "Choose a Fallback Pet Style", "Pick a default look if your photo upload needs fine-tuning.", "Select Style", "Continue"]
3: ["Select Your Desktop Journey", "Scroll through pet personalities and pick the companion style that fits your workflow."]
4: ["Pet not appearing? Check your system tray (bottom-right icons) or allow desktop overlay permissions."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a name to finalize its adoption registration.", "Pet Name", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
6: []
7: ["Pick a Path (You Can Change This Anytime)", "Select how you'd like your pet to interact with you today. You can freely switch paths later in app settings.", "No wrong choices! All paths unlock full desktop pet features."]
8: ["Preparing 3D pet models | Generating animations | Spawning desktop window"]
9: ["All Set! Meet Your Pet On Your Desktop", "Your companion is active and waiting for your commands.", "Try Your First Pet Commands", "Click on your pet or speak to see how it responds on your desktop.", "Test Wave Gesture", "Ready to Launch"]
